    Major current events as of April 2026 include intense global conflicts, with US military strikes reported in the Pacific amid tensions with Iran. Political shakeups are occurring, including the Tisza Party winning in Hungary and Rep. Eric Swalwell facing resignation calls over sexual misconduct allegations. Key stories include NASA’s Artemis II return, California wildfire fatalities, and a national AI data center boom. 
    Top Headlines 
    • War & Conflict: The U.S. military has conducted multiple strikes on suspected drug boats in the Pacific, killing several people. A blockade has been imposed on Iranian ports in the Strait of Hormuz.

      Hungarian opposition party Tisza has ended Viktor Orbán's 16-year rule. Pope Leo XIV is conducting a major Africa tour, amid tensions with the US administration.

    • Space & Tech: NASA's Artemis II has safely returned from its crewed moon flyby. Tech companies are rapidly building AI data centers, prompting local resistance.
    • Business & Consumer: Ground beef prices are soaring in the US. Investors are closely watching oil prices, which have dipped below $100, due to the ongoing Iran war volatility. 
    Key Investigations & Crime 
    • Bahamas Missing Person: The husband of a missing American woman has been released by police without charges.
    • Cruise Ship Murder: A 16-year-old from Florida has been charged with the sexual assault and killing of his stepsister on a cruise ship.
    • Roblox Safety: Roblox has introduced mandatory age-based accounts to address safety concerns.
